title: held-out rule (v1)
description: The rule that selects the held-out validation set of a revision proposal (AT-12, M section 5.6). It is frozen before any run: its digest sha256(JCS(document)) is supplied to `observed propose` from outside (the pre-registration), so the proposer cannot choose the held-out set at proposal time. The rule excludes whole episodes by episode key; every residual and occurrence of a held-out episode is held out.

held_out_episodes.description: Episode keys `episode:<case>:<item>:<n>`, or full episode_refs with the digest; an episode matches when its episode_ref equals the entry or starts with the entry followed by `@`.

statement.description: The rule in words, as frozen.
